## fetchVaultV2BluePublicAllocatorData() function

Fetches all BluePublicAllocator and Vault V2 cap data needed to simulate reallocations for one hydrated Vault V2.

Only `VaultV2MorphoMarketV1AdapterV2` adapters participate. The function derives every adapter-market id and shared vault allocation id from the hydrated vault, uses one deployless `eth_call` by default, and falls back to direct reads unless deployless mode is forced.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function fetchVaultV2BluePublicAllocatorData(vault: AccrualVaultV2, client: Client, parameters?: DeploylessFetchParameters & {
    readonly targetMarketParams?: MarketParams;
}): Promise<{
    publicAllocatorConfig: VaultV2BluePublicAllocatorConfig | undefined;
    activeAdapters: Set<`0x${string}`>;
    marketPublicAllocatorConfigs: Record<`0x${string}`, VaultV2BlueMarketPublicAllocatorConfig | undefined>;
    allocations: Record<`0x${string}`, IVaultV2Allocation | undefined>;
}>;
```

Promise&lt;{ publicAllocatorConfig: [VaultV2BluePublicAllocatorConfig](./blue-sdk.vaultv2bluepublicallocatorconfig.md) \| undefined; activeAdapters: Set&lt;\`0x${string}\`&gt;; marketPublicAllocatorConfigs: Record&lt;\`0x${string}\`, [VaultV2BlueMarketPublicAllocatorConfig](./blue-sdk.vaultv2bluemarketpublicallocatorconfig.md) \| undefined&gt;; allocations: Record&lt;\`0x${string}\`, [IVaultV2Allocation](./blue-sdk.ivaultv2allocation.md) \| undefined&gt;; }&gt;

Vault-wide config when the BluePublicAllocator is authorized, active-adapter set, adapter-market configs keyed by `adapterMarketCapId`<!-- -->, and allocations keyed by derived id.

## Exceptions

`UnknownAddressError` when the chain has no BluePublicAllocator deployment.

`UnsupportedChainIdError` when the chain is absent from the address registry.

`viem.BaseError` when deployless mode is forced and fails, or when a direct contract read fails.

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `parameters.account`<!-- -->: Optional account passed to viem calls.

- `parameters.blockNumber`<!-- -->: Optional block number for historical reads.

- `parameters.blockTag`<!-- -->: Optional block tag for historical reads.

- `parameters.stateOverride`<!-- -->: Optional viem state override.

- `parameters.chainId`<!-- -->: Optional chain id; defaults to `getChainId(client)`<!-- -->.

- `parameters.deployless`<!-- -->: Deployless mode; defaults to `true`<!-- -->, with direct-read fallback.

- `parameters.targetMarketParams`<!-- -->: Optional target market whose config and cap ids are fetched even when the adapter has no current position.

## Example


```ts
import type { AccrualVaultV2 } from "@morpho-org/blue-sdk";
import { fetchVaultV2BluePublicAllocatorData } from "@morpho-org/blue-sdk-viem";
import { createPublicClient, http } from "viem";
import { mainnet } from "viem/chains";

const client = createPublicClient({ chain: mainnet, transport: http() });
export async function fetchAllocatorData(
  vault: AccrualVaultV2,
) {
  const data = await fetchVaultV2BluePublicAllocatorData(vault, client);
  // data contains publicAllocatorConfig, activeAdapters, marketPublicAllocatorConfigs, and allocations.
  return data;
}
```
